$description: Borealis design tokens (Design Tokens Community Group format). Source for the Phase 2 token pipeline (ADR 0044). Dark only for 1.0 (ADR 0052). Surfaces, ink and status colours come from the LuminalShine Mission Control web UI; the gold accent family is replaced by violet. Alpha colours use 8-digit hex (#RRGGBBAA). Dimensions use the Android units dp and sp, which the token pipeline maps for Compose.

surface-raised.$description: Keys, popovers, elements on a surface

line-strong.$description: Input and button border, white at 12%

hover.$description: Row and button hover, white at 4%

scrim.$description: Behind dialogs and sheets, page at 72%

ink-4.$description: Hints and kickers. Mission Control uses #6F757C, raised to pass 4.5:1 on page and surface; use ink-3 on surface-raised

accent-soft.$description: Focus outline on TV and gamepad, accent text on dark overlays

accent-strong.$description: Accent borders and fills that carry no text

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on accent fills

accent-tint.$description: Selected rows, chips, focused rows, accent at 13%

accent-line.$description: Accent tag and chip borders, accent at 40%

success.$description: Status dot and fills: online, done

warning.$description: Status dot and fills: needs attention

danger.$description: Status dot and fills: failure, destructive

offline.$description: Status ring: offline or unknown, 3.5:1 on surface and 3.25:1 on surface-raised (WCAG 1.4.11)

minimum.$description: No text smaller than this on a TV

compact.$description: Dialog width: a question and its answer

standard.$description: Dialog width: a short form or a list

wide.$description: Dialog width: content that needs a wide line

handheld-fraction.$description: Width of a choice or action sheet on a handheld, as a fraction of the window, kept between the compact and standard dialog widths

content-max.$description: Widest content of a full screen; wider windows centre it

tv.$description: Width of the navigation rail and of the settings group list on a TV

handheld.$description: Width of the navigation rail and of the settings group list on a handheld

height-tv.$description: Minimum height of a host card on a TV, whatever its content: the fullest card (one row of tags, a running app) plus a few dp of margin for density rounding; a card whose tags wrap or whose font is large grows past it; a handheld or phone card is as high as its content

sheet.$description: Top corners of a bottom sheet

unit.$description: Base unit for layout rhythm; gutters and paddings use 2dp steps

dialog-padding.$description: Padding inside a dialog, all sides

dialog-margin.$description: Least distance between a dialog and the window edge

outline.$description: accent-soft outline on the focused element (TV, gamepad)

outline-thick.$description: Outline with the thicker focus setting and with high contrast, in the ink colour: 15.8:1 on page, 14.9:1 on surface and 6.9:1 on the brightest backdrop that a glass panel is allowed

tile-scale.$description: Scale of a focused cover tile

high-contrast.$description: Colours that replace the roles of the same name when High contrast is on (ADR 0057). Text is 7:1 or more on page, chrome, surface, surface-raised, and under the accent tint of a selected row and a hover; borders are opaque and 3:1 or more on the same fills.

ink-3.$description: Tertiary text, metadata: 9:1 on the worst of the fills

ink-4.$description: Hints and kickers: 7.5:1 on the worst of the fills

accent.$description: Accent fills and accent text: 7.5:1 on the worst of the fills, and on-accent keeps 10:1 on it

line.$description: Hairline border, opaque: 3.7:1 on the worst of the fills

line-strong.$description: Input and button border, opaque: 5.3:1 on the worst of the fills

accent-line.$description: Accent tag and chip borders, opaque

offline.$description: Status dot: offline or unknown, 3.9:1 on the worst of the fills

dim.$description: Opacity of the page colour laid over the animated background, so that text straight on it keeps 7:1 over the brightest pixel of every background

colour-vision.$description: Status colours of the colour-blind palettes (ADR 0057). Each palette is picked from the Okabe and Ito set, which is safe for colour vision deficiency, and checked with the Machado simulation of ColourMeasures.kt and ColourVisionPaletteTest.kt in the tests of :borealis:designsystem: every pair of the four status colours is 20 or more apart in CIEDE2000 for the dichromacies it is for, and each keeps 3:1 on page, surface and surface-raised. The inks are the colours lightened until they keep 7.5:1 as text.

red-green.$description: For protanopia and deuteranopia: blue for success, yellow for warning, vermillion for danger and neutral grey for offline. 23.7 or more apart for both.

offline.$description: Neutral grey, which every dichromacy sees as it is

blue-yellow.$description: For tritanopia: bluish green for success, yellow for warning, vermillion for danger and neutral grey for offline. 23.9 or more apart for tritanopia.

offline.$description: Neutral grey, which every dichromacy sees as it is
